blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Municipality of Ginatilan has imposed strict livestock movement and trading restrictions after African Swine Fever (ASF) was confirmed in two barangays. The restrictions took effect on Sept. 19, 2026, under an executive order that Mayor Roy Vincent Singco issued. The order followed laboratory results from the Department of Agriculture (DA) 7 Regional Animal Disease Diagnostic Laboratory that confirmed ASF in Barangays Cagsing and Calabawan. The measure aims to contain the disease within the affected areas, prevent its spread to other barangays, and block the entry of livestock from high-risk areas.
